deprecation.message: This version transitively restores Blazor.Common.Analyzers 2.0.0, which was signed with a since-revoked code-signing certificate, so NuGet restore fails (NU3012). Use 3.4.0, which depends on the re-signed Blazor.Common.Analyzers 2.1.0.
